SELECT id, station_name, city, py_code, create_time FROM ( SELECT s.id, s.station_name, s.city, s.py_code, s.create_time, CASE WHEN s.city = #{keyword} THEN 1 WHEN UPPER(s.py_code) = UPPER(#{keyword}) THEN 1 WHEN s.station_name LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') THEN 2 WHEN s.city LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') THEN 3 WHEN UPPER(s.py_code) LIKE CONCAT(UPPER(#{keyword}), '%') THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS match_rank FROM t_station s WHERE s.station_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.city LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR UPPER(s.py_code) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{keyword}), '%') OR s.city IN (SELECT DISTINCT c.city FROM t_station c WHERE c.city LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR UPPER(c.py_code) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{keyword}), '%') OR c.station_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ) t ORDER BY match_rank, city, station_name LIMIT 50
